tasks.title: Create PolicyMatchService with in-memory rule cache
tasks.description: Load all active rules from both schemas at init. O(1) per-tuple lookup keyed by (matchType, entityType, value).

tasks.title: Implement match-order: deny first, then allow
tasks.description: At most one match. Multi-deny tie-break: lowest UUID lexicographically (deterministic).

tasks.title: Honor time bounds at match time
tasks.description: Future validFrom / past validUntil / active false MUST NOT match.

tasks.title: Implement match types exact, normalized, bsn, kvk
tasks.description: normalized strips case + accents (Transliterator). Reject unknown types defensively.

tasks.title: Subscribe to object-changed events for cache invalidation
tasks.description: On any change to either policy schema, invalidate and rebuild the in-memory index.

tasks.title: Unit-test PolicyMatchService
tasks.description: Each match type, time bounds, active flag, multi-rule precedence, multi-deny tie-break, deny-vs-allow conflict.

tasks.title: Extend ConsentService::createConsentRequest with policy lookup
tasks.description: Deny match → mandatory_anonymized + policyMatch + skipped notification. Allow match → blanket_consent_given + policyMatch + skipped notification. No match → existing WOO unchanged.

tasks.title: Block transitions out of policy-pre-empted states
tasks.description: FROM mandatory_anonymized or blanket_consent_given TO any WOO state must be rejected.

tasks.title: Unit-test the four detection-time outcomes
tasks.description: no match → WOO; deny → mandatory_anonymized; allow → blanket_consent_given; both → deny wins.

tasks.title: Force-resolve in-flight records on deny rule INSERT
tasks.description: On deny rule add (or update making it match more entities), update matching in-flight publicationConsent records to mandatory_anonymized + policyMatch + cancel notifications.

tasks.title: Do NOT modify in-flight records on allow rule INSERT
tasks.description: Allow-list addition leaves existing publicationConsent records as-is. Future detections benefit.

tasks.title: Preserve past records on rule DELETE / expiry
tasks.description: Past publicationConsent records keep their final state. Future detections fall through.

tasks.title: Unit-test retroactive force-resolve
tasks.description: Including the case where in-flight record had objection_received (deny overrides explicit objection — privacy default).

tasks.title: Render anonymization toggle per consentStatus
tasks.description: mandatory_anonymized → ON locked. blanket_consent_given → OFF defaulted enabled. Others → existing UX.

tasks.title: Override-up flow for blanket_consent_given
